name: BLITZ
rule: BLITZ = the noise-area momentum scalp (scalp-momentum.md na_scalp) + one filter: trade only when the PRIOR day's 09:30-16:00 range is at least 0.8 x its 14-day mean. Checks at the 1m closes of 11:00, 11:30 ... 15:30 ET: a close above the 09:30 open x (1 + sigma) buys, below open x (1 - sigma) sells (sigma = mean |close / 09:30 open - 1| at that minute over the last 14 sessions); market at the next open (+1 tick); stop 1.5 x the 14-bar ATR of 5m bars; after +1R the stop trails 1.5R behind the best price; out after 30 minutes or at 15:55; one position, max 6 a day, -3R day stop.
note: entry_t = open of the fill bar, exit_t = end of the exit bar (ET); prices include 1 tick on market and stop fills; $ = pts x $2 x micros - $1.90 a micro.
